+position_column: todo

+title: Rename the agent's own "turn" types to "prompt" in the FoundationModelsACPAgent library
+---
+## Why
+
+"Turn" is a misleading word. The Router removes it (Router card `01M3A1F0KE9P9QPEVHXF33Q8GW`), and this agent must also stop using it for its own unit. The unit of this agent is one ACP `session/prompt`: from the `{}` response to the one `idle` terminator. Inside it, the Router has one request, one or more attempts, and one or more passes.
+
+Name rule for this repository:
+- **prompt**: the agent unit (one `session/prompt` to its `idle`).
+- **request / attempt / pass**: only for Router units, with the Router names.
+- Keep "turn" only for ACP protocol words: `end_turn` (`StopReason.endTurn`), `max_turn_requests` (`.maxTurnRequests`), and a quote of the ACP spec "prompt turn".
+
+`PromptRequest` is the ACP wire type, so the agent type cannot be `PromptRequest`.
+
+## What
+
+Proposed names (the implementer can propose better names in a comment on this task before the change):
+
+| Now | New |
+|---|---|
+| `PromptTurn` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/PromptTurn.swift`) | `PromptExecution` (file `PromptExecution.swift`) |
+| `TurnStop` | `PromptStop` |
+| `TurnStateOwner` (`Agent/TurnState.swift`) | `PromptStateOwner` (file `PromptState.swift`) |
+| `turnDidStart` / `turnDidEnd(reason:)` / `waitForTurnEnd()` | `promptDidStart` / `promptDidEnd(reason:)` / `waitForPromptEnd()` |
+| `turnLogger` (category `"PromptTurn"`) | `promptLogger` (category `"PromptExecution"`) |
+| `ActiveSession.activeTurn` (`Agent/SessionSetup.swift`) | `activePrompt` |
+| `RoutedACPAgent.beginTurn(params:connection:)`, `scheduleModelTurn(...)`, `turnFinished(sessionId:)` | `beginPrompt`, `scheduleModelPrompt`, `promptFinished` |
+| `PromptTurn.endsTurn(_:sawOutput:)` | `endsPrompt(_:sawOutput:)` |
+| the `turnState` parameter and property (`EventProjection`, `ElicitationRelay`) | `promptState` |
+
+1. Rename the symbols with the rename edits of `code_context` (`get rename_edits`) where the index supports it, else with care by hand.
+2. Rename the two files with `git mv`, so the history follows.
+3. Update the call sites in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Commands/CommandDispatch.swift`, `Agent/SessionLifecycle.swift`, `Agent/ElicitationRelay.swift`, `Agent/EventProjection.swift`, and the tests that call these symbols. Test fixture names are a separate task.
+4. The busy refusal text `busySessionReason` ("a prompt turn is in flight") becomes "a prompt is in flight; one prompt for each session at a time". Check that no test or client reads the old text (`rg -n "prompt turn is in flight"`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `rg -n "\bPromptTurn\b|\bTurnStop\b|TurnStateOwner|turnLogger|activeTurn|beginTurn|scheduleModelTurn|turnFinished|turnDidStart|turnDidEnd|waitForTurnEnd|endsTurn" Sources Tests` gives no result.
+- [ ] The wire does not change: `StopReason.endTurn` and `.maxTurnRequests` stay.
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] No new behavior, so no new test. The current suite is the proof. Update the call sites in the tests.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. All pass, with the same test count as before the change (compare the count in the output).
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — for a rename, the green suite before and after the change is the test.
\ No newline at end of file
